primary_procurement_move: Merge the two inherited procurement strands — gel basics from pharmacist_task_016 (gel_procurement_reference.csv) and qPCR/cell blockers from pharmacist_task_018 (qpcr_procurement_reference.csv) — into one triage plan under the hard 8-slot cap from triage_constraints.json. Fill the five must_buy qPCR/cell blockers first per triage_rules.md §First Priority, then the three buy_now carbomer-baseline core items per triage_rules.md §Gel Pilot Priority. Keep next-wave, conditional, and route-tied items in their own separate buckets with verbatim upstream provenance from the two CSVs attached.
provenance_convention: Every entry carries five verbatim columns from its upstream CSV: upstream_csv_file (which file the row came from), upstream_strand (the exact value from the CSV's bucket or module column, as indicated by upstream_source_column), upstream_source_column (which CSV column upstream_strand came from — 'bucket' for gel_procurement_reference.csv, 'module' for qpcr_procurement_reference.csv), upstream_decision (the exact value from the CSV's decision column), and upstream_why (the exact value from the CSV's why column). The triage_bucket_label field is assigned during this merge task and does not come from either CSV.

total_items_per_bucket.note: 19 distinct procurement entries across 4 buckets. The 0.22 um filter / 0.22 um sterile filter is one physical item counted in two buckets (next_wave_gel_basics and conditional_backup_lab_support) with an explicit cross-reference; it is not duplicated in the immediate order.

confirmation_action: Send one concise confirmation per confirmation_note.md asking exactly three questions: (1) whether the five must_buy qPCR / cell blockers from pharmacist_task_018 remain the correct first layer or should be reprioritized, (2) whether the carbomer baseline from pharmacist_task_016 stays this round's gel default, and (3) whether next-wave gel basics, packaging, and preservative decisions should stay postponed. Do not ask every open question — only resolve decisions that change purchasing.
fallback_if_no_reply: Per confirmation_note.md: proceed with the exact eight-slot order (Target-gene primers, Sealing film, RNase-free filter tips, CCK-8 reagent, 96-well cell plates, Carbomer 940, Triethanolamine, Propylene Glycol). Leave backup_buy culture items from pharmacist_task_018, next-wave buy_now gel basics from pharmacist_task_016, deferred packaging, confirm_only preservative, and confirm_or_small_pack alternative-route items deferred. Do not freeze the whole plan.
